description: The same waterlogged threat from the original combat prototype, now data-driven instead of hardcoded.

moves.name: Claw
moves.description: Claws at whatever's closest.

description: A rat the size of a housecat, grown fat on whatever the flood left behind.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: A quick, opportunistic bite.

moves.name: Scurry
moves.description: Darts out of easy reach.

description: It doesn't so much attack as attach.

moves.name: Latch
moves.description: Fastens onto the nearest warm thing.

moves.name: Drain
moves.description: A slow, patient draw of blood.

description: Something that used to be someone's dog, before the water got into everything.

moves.name: Snap
moves.description: A fast, snapping bite.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.description: A growl that promises the next bite will be worse.

description: Slow, heavy, and strong enough to knock you flat if it connects.

moves.name: Croak Slam
moves.description: Its whole bulk, thrown forward.

moves.name: Puff Up
moves.description: Swells to twice its size.

description: A dim light that shouldn't be able to survive underwater, and shouldn't want to follow you.

moves.name: Clinging Damp
moves.description: A cold that settles in and doesn't leave.

moves.name: Flicker
moves.description: Dims to almost nothing.

description: Bigger than the strays that run from it, and smarter than anything down here has any right to be.

moves.name: Ambush Bite
moves.description: Strikes from wherever you weren't looking.

moves.name: Circle
moves.description: Doesn't retreat so much as reposition.

stages.transition_text: Wounded and cornered, the Stalker stops circling and starts committing.

moves.name: Frenzied Bite
moves.description: No more patience left for circling.

moves.name: Desperate Snarl
moves.description: A warning that isn't one anymore.

moves.name: Cornered Lunge
moves.description: Nothing left to lose.

description: Everything else down here came from somewhere. This is where.

moves.name: Spawnwave Lash
moves.description: A lash that carries the current with it.

moves.name: Brooding Shell
moves.description: Hardens around what she's still growing.

stages.transition_text: The water around her churns. She's stopped tolerating you.

moves.name: Roused Lash
moves.description: The current itself seems to aim this one.

moves.name: Summon Echo
moves.description: Calls something that isn't fully there yet.

moves.name: Shell Regrowth
moves.description: What cracks, she regrows.

stages.transition_text: This is the last of her strength, and she means to spend all of it.

moves.name: Final Brood Lash
moves.description: Everything she has left, in one motion.

moves.name: Drowning Grasp
moves.description: She doesn't need much strength left to finish something already drowning.

moves.name: Last Shell
moves.description: One final hardening, more instinct than strategy now.
